'''Vaylin's lightsaber''' was a [[Color/Legends|yellow]]-bladed [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] wielded by [[Vaylin]], daughter of [[Tenebrae|Valkorion]] and [[Empress/Legends|Empress]] of [[Zakuul]].

==History==
[[File:VaylinWithLightsaber-SWTOR.jpg|thumb|200px|left|Vaylin with her lightsaber]]
As a child, Vaylin displayed an immensive display of power that scared even her father. To control her, Valkorion sent his duaghter to [[Nathema]], where she was subjected to brutal mental conditioning. When she eventually was allowed to return, Valkorion gifted her the [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]<ref name="KOTETchapter7">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|chapter=7}}</ref> with a yellow blade and a hilt bearing Zakuulan ornamental motifs.<ref name="Cartel" /> Vaylin used this lightsaber during her service as a [[High Justice]] to both her father and brother [[Arcann]] who succeeded him as Eternal Emperor. She used it rarely however, relying on her immense strength in [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], which caused her [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|lightsaber combat]] skills to become somewhat lacking.<ref name="KOTFEchapter8" />

During her [[Rescue of the Outlander|pursuit]] of the escaped [[Alliance Commander|Outlander]], Vaylin ignited her lightsaber after cornering her foe, only to turn it back off, confident that she wouldn't need it.<ref>{{TORcite|exp=kotfe|chapter=3}}</ref> She used it to duel her [[Senya Tirall|mother]] on [[Asylum]], only to be surprised when Senya managed to disarm her.<ref name="KOTFEchapter8" /> When the [[Eternal Throne]] was taken over by [[SCORPIO]], Vaylin burst into the room with her lightsaber at the ready, only to turn it off when SCORPIO explained her motives and allowed Vaylin to claim the Throne as her own.<ref>{{TORcite|exp=kotfe|chapter=16}}</ref> Seeking vengeance against her mother, Vaylin tracked Senya to [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]], where she ambushed and dueled her once again.<ref name="Betrayed">{{TORweb|url=info/media/trailers/star-wars-old-republic-&ndash;-knights-eternal-throne-&ndash;-‘betrayed’-trailer|text="Betrayed"|int=Betrayed}}</ref>

[[File:Senya_Tirall_duels_Vaylin.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Vaylin uses her lightsaber against her mother.]]
SCORPIO became Vaylin's advisor and helped her stage an [[Assault on the Gravestone|assault on the ''Gravestone'']], during which Vaylin used her lightsaber to intimidate captured [[Eternal Alliance|Alliance]] members, but ultimate resolved not to use it.<ref>{{TORcite|exp=kotet|chapter=3}}</ref> During the [[Grand Festival of Empress Vaylin]] her brother Arcann reemerged after healing from his injuries, and Vaylin dueled him to defend her claim of the Eternal Throne. Afterwards Vaylin returned to Nathema, which was a [[Force void/Legends|Void in the Force]]. Surprised by being unable to access the Force, Vaylin has to relied on her lightsaber to defend against mutated [[Acklay/Legends|acklays]] in [[Jarak]]'s laboratory.<ref>{{TORcite|exp=kotet|chapter=7}}</ref> Vaylin soon met her fate on [[Odessen]], where she engaged Arcann, Senya and the Outlander housing her father's spirit in combat, only to have her mortal form struck down.<ref>{{TORcite|exp=kotet|chapter=8}}</ref>
